title: PCEP: Added support of draft-ietf-pce-segment-routing-policy-cp-05 (PCEP extension to support Segment Routing Policy Candidate Paths)
description:
This Pull Request adds the support of draft-ietf-pce-segment-routing-policy-cp-05 (PCEP extension to support Segment Routing Policy Candidate Paths)
The document is now stable and has IANA assigned codes. There has been interoperability tests recently with the extensions defined in the document.
In the PR, it is added:
- SR Policy Name TLV
- SR Policy Candidate Path Identifiers TLV
- SR Policy Candidate Path Name TLV
- SR Policy Candidate Path Preference TLV
- Association Type 6
- Extended Association ID TLV format for assoc_type 6 included. For the rest of cases, the TLV is docoded in an opaque way. This is the only TLV whose decoding needs knowdledge of the object in which it is encoded.
In addition, some clean up of code comments the latest PR I made are included.

In order to facilitate the testing please find attached pcaps with the association object of association type 6. 
[TRACE_WITH_SEGMENT_ROUTING_CP.pcap](/uploads/59fdf95a64585df39d5ecd4fc164c69c/TRACE_WITH_SEGMENT_ROUTING_CP.pcap)
